propositions: Operators use --force to close 25% of audited tickets (33 FORCE_CLOSE records) for administrative reasons (duplicate, obsolete, wontfix) where completion verification cannot pass and is not the intent.

Non-bug tickets (task/story/epic) have no truthful administrative close path today because close_precheck.py gates non-completion dispositions to bugs only and DISPOSITION_CLASSES omits obsolete/superseded/wontfix.
The completion-FAIL refusal message never mentions the narrow disposition path that exists, leaving operators unaware of a legitimate alternative to --force.
obsolete and wontfix administrative closes require a reason/justification as a prerequisite, enforced at write time (txn.transition_core) independently of gate state.
A reason-only administrative disposition (obsolete/wontfix) must produce a signed attestation whose manifest declares the class and reason line, distinct from replacement-bearing dispositions.
The close refusal message must enumerate the applicable --class values for the ticket's type to make the truthful administrative exit discoverable.
